content.title: List of Major League Baseball players from Venezuela
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Since 1939, over 400 Venezuelan baseball players have played in Major League Baseball. This list shows players who appeared in at least one game in MLB, including number indicating order of arrival, name of player, position, starting team, and dates of debut and final game.
